items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: A very, very nice trio. But it's always been a problem to get bookings, and so we didn't last too long, and Red went back to California and I stayed in New York

ctx.x: But I had heard pianists like that, and I was very highly inspired by playing the piano then. Not only that but I had some competition in that particular city. There was an orchestra there who later on I found out came from Omaha, Nebraska, where I later played with my first large band of importance. But at this time there was an orchestra by the name of Red -- I can't think of his last name. Isn't that something?
Was he also a high school student?
